operatorProperties.code:
def process(wildfires):
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    df = wildfires.copy()
    # July filter based on start_date month
    df = df[df['start_date'].dt.month == 7]

    # Keep valid numeric pairs
    df = df[['hec', 'wind_med']].copy()
    df['hec'] = pd.to_numeric(df['hec'], errors='coerce')
    df['wind_med'] = pd.to_numeric(df['wind_med'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna()

    # Pearson and Spearman correlations
    pearson = df['hec'].corr(df['wind_med'], method='pearson') if len(df) > 1 else np.nan
    spearman = df['hec'].corr(df['wind_med'], method='spearman') if len(df) > 1 else np.nan

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'n_july': int(len(df)),
        'pearson_corr': pearson,
        'spearman_corr': spearman,
        'abs_pearson': abs(pearson) if pd.notna(pearson) else np.nan,
        'abs_spearman': abs(spearman) if pd.notna(spearman) else np.nan,
    }])
